Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		pc: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(pc|pc.Id = id)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		let newPc: ProductCatalog in
		newPc.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newPc) and
		newPc.Id = id and
		newPc.Name = name and
		result = true or
		pc.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = false
}
